added.author: Greeks.live
added.title: Selloff lifts IV as the market prices further downside
added.view: Greeks.live called the market very fragile with BTC at $75K, warning that converging bearish factors could trigger margin liquidations. It said the decline clearly pushed up implied volatility and that concern about further downside is evident. It expects better opportunities in the first half of 2027.

added.author: Block Scholes
added.title: Short-dated BTC vol and put skew jump
added.view: Block Scholes said 7-day BTC at-the-money vol spiked from 33% to 43% and 7-day 25-delta skew widened from -0.5 to -8.3 vol points, later easing to about -6.2. Its 30-day BSIV stood at 42.9% for BTC and 63.0% for ETH.

added.author: Block Scholes
added.title: ETH vol leads as ETH/BTC hits a four-month low
added.view: Block Scholes said ETH was lagging hardest, down about 8% to $2,044 with ETH/BTC at its lowest since July. ETH 30-day implied vol rose 7.9 points over seven days to 60.1%, while BTC 30-day vol was 41.2%.

added.author: Block Scholes
added.title: Options volume cools from early-November peak; ETH flow call-led
added.view: Block Scholes said BTC options volume eased from a peak near $8.1B on Nov 4 to mostly $2.8B to $4.9B a day, with calls and puts close to evenly split. ETH volume held firm and calls made up about 57% of turnover; HYPE calls took 54%.

added.author: Glassnode
added.title: Protection demand stays high after failed push above $80K
added.view: In its BTC Market Pulse, Glassnode said BTC traded near $75K after a failed push above $80K, with ETF outflows the heaviest since early July. It said leverage and demand for protection stay high.

added.author: Volmex
added.title: BVIV hits its highest level since June
added.view: Volmex said its BVIV index, which tracks Bitcoin's 30-day implied volatility, hit its highest level since June 2026.
